Therefore, the Anduvia system must also be a part of the Outer Expansion Zone.</ref>

The '''Anduvia system''' was located in the [[Immalia sector/Legends|Immalia sector]]. It was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], being located both in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of that region.<ref name="Location" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Immalia system/Legends|Immalia]] and [[Vorian system/Legends|Vorian systems]].<ref name="EGtW" />

The Anduvia system was the origin point of [[Anduvian salt tablet]]s,<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Anduvian salt tablet]]s|system=Anduvia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and it fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Anduvia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square K-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
